query:
UPDATE "quests" AS q
                    SET
                        sequence = n.row_n
                    FROM (
                        SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id, chain ORDER BY q.sequence, q.updated ASC) row_n
                        FROM
                            quests q
                        WHERE
                            chain = $1
                            AND user_id = $2
                        ORDER BY
                            chain,
                            row_n
                    ) AS n
                    WHERE
                        n.id = q.id;
